cases.title: Verify both Classic and Modern themes exist under theme preferences
cases.description: Navigate to the theme preferences and verify that both Classic and Modern themes are present in the list.

cases.title: Verify theme preferences behavior when theme definitions are missing
cases.description: Check the behavior of the theme preferences panel when no themes are defined or the theme list is empty.

cases.title: Verify Classic theme display matching the reference image
cases.description: Select the Classic theme under preferences and verify that its visual layout and styling match the provided reference image.

cases.title: Verify Classic theme asset failure handling
cases.description: Verify the behavior when Classic theme assets fail to load, ensuring it handles missing resources gracefully without crashing.

cases.title: Verify Modern Theme Visual Appearance
cases.description: Select the Modern theme under theme preferences and verify it is displayed exactly as shown in the given reference image.

cases.title: Verify Modern Theme Rendering Failure Handling
cases.description: Verify the behavior when Modern theme assets fail to load, ensuring it does not crash the application and handles unstyled UI states correctly.

cases.title: Verify Theme Preferences item exists under View menu
cases.description: Click the View menu and verify that the 'Theme Preferences' item is available.

cases.title: Verify Theme Preferences item availability via keyboard navigation
cases.description: Open the View menu using keyboard navigation and verify the 'Theme Preferences' item is present and selectable.

analysis.analysis: For R-175: Normal scenario includes navigating to theme preferences and verifying both Classic and Modern themes exist. Edge and boundary scenarios include checking behavior when theme preferences load with no themes or missing theme definitions. Abnormal scenarios include theme preferences failing to load or displaying corrupted theme lists. For R-176: Normal scenario includes selecting and verifying the Classic theme matches the given image. Edge scenarios include checking Classic theme rendering at minimum and maximum window resolutions. Abnormal scenarios include Classic theme assets failing to load resulting in unstyled UI. For R-177: Normal scenario includes selecting and verifying the Modern theme matches the given image. Edge scenarios include checking Modern theme rendering at minimum and maximum window resolutions. Abnormal scenarios include Modern theme assets failing to load resulting in unstyled UI. For R-178: Normal scenario includes clicking the View menu and verifying 'Theme Preferences' is available. Edge scenarios include checking keyboard navigation to 'Theme Preferences' within the View menu. Abnormal scenarios include View menu failing to open or missing 'Theme Preferences' item. For R-179: Normal scenario includes clicking the View menu and verifying 'Get New Themes' is available. Edge scenarios include checking keyboard navigation to 'Get New Themes' within the View menu. Abnormal scenarios include View menu failing to open or missing 'Get New Themes' item. For R-180: Normal scenario includes clicking the View menu and verifying 'Classic' is available. Edge scenarios include checking keyboard navigation to 'Classic' within the View menu. Abnormal scenarios include View menu failing to open or missing 'Classic' item. For R-181: Normal scenario includes clicking the View menu and verifying 'Modern' is available. Edge scenarios include checking keyboard navigation to 'Modern' within the View menu. Abnormal scenarios include View menu failing to open or missing 'Modern' item.
